title: Localization of an algebraic dualizing complex
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $S\subseteq R$ contain $1$ and be closed under multiplication, and put $B=S^{-1}R$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Let $K^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of $R$-modules representing an algebraic dualizing complex in $D(R)$ [def-per-algebraic-normalized-dualizing]. The complex with degree-$j$ term $S^{-1}K^j$ and differential $S^{-1}d_K^j$ represents an algebraic dualizing complex over $B$. The multiplicative subset may contain $0$, so the zero localization is included.
